narration: Seventy percent of all inherited wealth is completely gone within one generation. Not because of taxes — because of psychology. And the math is brutal.
visual: Dark background. Giant '70%' springs onto screen. Below it: 'OF INHERITED WEALTH' in amber. A $1,000,000 counter beneath slowly counts down toward zero. Bottom text: 'GONE IN ONE GENERATION' in red.

narration: Here's the thing — people who build wealth develop habits over decades. Heirs don't inherit those habits. They just inherit the balance. And that gap is everything.
visual: Light background. Two person silhouettes side by side. Left: 'WEALTH BUILDER' with a growing bar chart showing years of discipline. Right: 'HEIR' with a full bar that rapidly shrinks. Labels showing 30 years vs 3 years.

narration: Number one thing heirs do? Lifestyle inflation. Bigger house, nicer car, luxury vacations — all in year one before they understand what they actually have.
visual: Dark background. Three icons animate in from left: a house growing larger, a car upgrading to a sports car, a suitcase with destination tags. Each has an amber price tag subtracting from an inheritance counter at the top.

narration: Studies tracking five thousand wealthy families found ninety percent of fortunes are gone by the third generation. That's not bad luck — that's a pattern.
visual: Light background. Three piggy banks in a row labeled 'Generation 1,' 'Generation 2,' 'Generation 3.' Gen 1 is full and golden. Gen 2 is half-full with a crack. Gen 3 is empty and broken. Percentage labels: 100%, 30%, 10%.

narration: The $84 trillion Great Wealth Transfer is happening right now. And without the right habits, most of that money won't make it to your grandchildren.
visual: Dark background. '$84 TRILLION' in massive amber text with a transfer arrow pointing from an older person silhouette to a younger one. A crack appears through the arrow. A progress bar showing 'Currently Transferring' fills across the screen.

narration: Whether you're building wealth or expecting to inherit it, habits matter more than the balance. The money follows the mindset — follow for the mindset shift.
visual: Light background. Two diverging path arrows: left path labeled 'HABITS' leads to a growing chart icon. Right path labeled 'WINDFALL ONLY' leads to a zero. A person silhouette stands at the fork choosing the left path. Follow prompt at bottom.
